Name: Machine Check
Author: lucaskchang
Description:
Using a configurable hotkey the player can save tiles that they want to be checked each day to see if there is a machine that has produced an item. In the morning, if any of the tiles the player has saved has produced an item, the player will receive a message with the name they chose for that tile and the tile's location.

[size=4][u]Usage:
[/u][/size]To save a tile press the configurable hotkey ("J" by default) and enter in a name for that tile.
To unsave a tile, simply press the same hotkey on the tile you want to unsave.
[b]You must sleep/save in order for your changes to be saved.[/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]

[/url][size=4][u]Demo:[/u][/size][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iNYV772LFV8]
[/url][youtube]l2rkyzm3lCE[/youtube]

[size=4][u]Compatible With:[/u][/size]
[size=2]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/size]
- Stardew Valley 1.5
- Smapi 3.12

[size=4][u]Console Commands:
[/u][/size]machinecheck_list <location>: Lists all saved tiles in the location the player specified. (Location names are case sensitive.)
machinecheck_clear <location>: Clears all saved tiles in the location the player specified. (Location names are case sensitive.)

[size=4][u]Config:
[/u][/size]MachineCheck Hotkey: Configurable hotkey to save tiles
Auto Unsave: Toggles whether or not tiles are unsaved once their notification is sent

[size=4][u]Known Issues:[/u][/size]
-This mod uses the default naming menu function from Stardew Valley so there is a random name button in the naming menu.
- In multiplayer, this mod will only work for the host.
